cohort: Uncomplicated pregnant women between 37 and 42 weeks of gestation who had meconium-stained amniotic fluid following spontaneous or artificial rupture of membrane.
finding: Meconium-stained amniotic fluid was associated with abnormal fetal heart rate, higher rates of cesarean and instrumental delivery, lower APGAR scores, and increased NICU admissions.
mod_finding: 28% of the exposed group had spontaneous vaginal delivery, 22% had instrumental delivery, and 50% had cesarean section.
